breakdown.summary: A 10.97 s square (1080x1080, 30 fps, CFR) Apple Maps concept by a motion designer: an app list, a title, a 3D fly-through into the Maps icon, a pin that morphs into a 'Directions' button, three destination cards (Dolomites, Lake Tahoe, Mount Fuji) linked by a drawn route the camera whips along, a map card that grows to full frame, and a logo end card that fades to the opening grey so it loops. Everything is a virtual camera over flat UI elements; motion blur on every move and letter-by-letter typing give it the 'premium app ad' feel. 108 BPM, one drop at f68 (00:00:02:08) which is exactly where the fly-through starts.
breakdown.hook: f0-89 (00:00:00:00-00:00:02:29): the first 3 frames are a blurred whip of app icons with a negative frame (f1) and a scanline frame (f3) - a jolt before anything is readable; f3-38 an iOS-style list scrolls up with labels typing in (iMessage, Settings, Maps, Mail); f38-45 the list scatters and 'Let's Plan' flies in, f45-53 'Your [Maps] Adventure' types in; f68 the drop and the camera dives into the icon. Nothing is said; the whole hook is motion + typing + one strong beat-synced move.

Title 'Let's Plan' (bold dark) + 'Your [icon] Adventure' (bold + regular), centred, letters flying/typing in f38-53 (00:00:01:08-00:00:01:23)
Blue 'Directions' pill with a navigation arrow - first morphed from the pin f105-109 (00:00:03:15-00:00:03:19), then part of every card

Destination cards: white rounded square, photo on top, bold name + light country line + the pill; the name types in (Dolomites f129-137 (00:00:04:09-00:00:04:17)); Lake Tahoe and Mount Fuji arrive already labelled
Blue route stroke drawn ahead of the camera between cards f144-216 (00:00:04:24-00:00:07:06)
Map card label 'Ridgecrest' + 'Working remotely' (white, lower-left) typing in f260-278 (00:00:08:20-00:00:09:08)
End card: memoji + 'olafmotion' wordmark (light + bold) on black f302-328 (00:00:10:02-00:00:10:28)
breakdown.broll: No footage. The 'shots' are UI cards with still photos inside (Dolomites, Lake Tahoe, Mount Fuji) and a map tile; the camera moves, the pictures do not.
breakdown.sound: One music track at 108 BPM (a rap track; the speech-to-text transcript is its lyrics, not narration), with one measured drop at f68 (00:00:02:08). No voice, no separate sound effects detected; the cuts land on beats half the time (50 % of plain cuts, and the key moves: the drop f68, the whip peak f167, the Fuji landing f218, the defocus f251, the end card f302).
breakdown.cta: None spoken or written; the end card is the author's logo (f302-328). The loop frame at f328 sends the viewer back to the start.
transitions: 3D fly-through (zoom transition) into the Maps icon on the drop, f68-99 (00:00:02:08-00:00:03:09): accelerating dolly into the icon with a perspective tilt, then a decelerating pull-back from the pin
Glitch cut f110-112 (00:00:03:20-00:00:03:22): one scanline frame, one black frame, one negative frame, then the new look; also used to open the video (f1 negative, f3 scanlines)
Camera whips along a drawn route, f148-176 and f199-225: accelerating (slow start) into 14-16 % of the width per frame with motion blur, decelerating (slow end) onto the next card
Defocus + white-out with the cut hidden at f249 (00:00:08:09): blur out 5 frames, blur in 5 frames
Zoom-out + blur into the end card f298-302 (00:00:09:28-00:00:10:02), fade to black, fade up to a flat 89 % grey loop frame at f328
breakdown.camera: All virtual (post): a camera over a flat layout that pushes in (f28-33, f48-54), dollies through the icon in 3D (f68-82), pans and whips along the route (f148-176, f204-225), eases back (f231-239, f298-301) and zooms the map card to full frame (f266-283). Every move carries motion blur; the eases are slow-start into the move and slow-end onto the element.
breakdown.grade: Measured: desaturated, bright (high-key), low contrast, lifted blacks - brightness 85 %, saturation 10 %. That is the design, not a grade: a flat light-grey background (#e5e1ea, about 89 % luma) with saturated UI accents (Apple blue #2a8ff1 pills and route, the icon's green / pink / yellow). The only dark parts are the designed black frames (f111, f305-321) and the end card. Rebuild: a light-grey Background, no LUT.
breakdown.rhythm: 60 cuts/min by the lab's count but most 'cuts' are designed single frames; really 5 scenes in 11 s, each 1.5-2.5 s. 108 BPM, beat every 16.6 frames; the big moves sit on beats (drop f68, whip peak f167, landing f218, defocus centre f251, end card f302) while the typing and holds run between them. One drop only, used for the one 3D move.
rebuild_tips: Build it as a layout, not a cut list: one Fusion comp (or AE comp) with every card placed on a big canvas and a route Polyline between them; animate ONE camera/Transform that travels card to card. Motion Blur (Quality 8, Shutter 360) on that transform is what sells it.
Time the five key moves to beats first (tools\beats.py on the user's song): the fly-through on the drop, each whip peak and each landing within 1 frame of a beat; let the typing fill the gaps.
Use the glitch cut as the signature: 1 scanline frame + 1 black frame + 1 inverted frame between looks (f110-112), and open the video with the same 3 frames so the loop closes.
Type every label in: Text+ Write On, one character per 1-2 frames, each letter blurred for 2 frames; cards grow out of their button (scale from the pill's corner, 6 frames, ease out).
Transitions by focus, not by cut: blur out 5 frames + white background up, cut, blur in 5 frames (f244-257); and a zoom into a card until it fills the frame (f266-277, 12 frames, S-curve).
End on the brand on black, then fade to the SAME light grey as frame 0 so the short loops (the last frame is a flat 89 % grey, not white); keep it square 1080x1080 for the feed.

effects.label: Text / graphics
effects.what: An app list (iMessage, Settings, Maps, Mail) scrolls upward continuously from f3 (00:00:00:03) to f38 (00:00:01:08), each row sliding in from below with vertical motion blur and sharpening as it slows. The labels type in one letter at a time as their row arrives: 'iMessage' f4-10 (00:00:00:04-00:00:00:10), 'Settings' f5-12, 'Maps' f10-19 (00:00:00:10-00:00:00:19), 'Mail' f21-31 (00:00:00:21-00:00:01:01). Rows leaving at the top fade out (iMessage f24-29). Before it, the hook f0-2 (00:00:00:00-00:00:00:02) is a different list (Apple Music / Apple TV icons) whipping past with heavy blur; f1 is a one-frame NEGATIVE of the picture (cyan and magenta icons on black) and f3 a one-frame horizontal SCANLINE frame over the new list - the same glitch frames used again at f110-112.
effects.timing: not on a beat (nearest beat +4.2 frames from the key frame)
effects.easing: scroll: linear with a decelerating (slow end) settle per row; letters: one character every 1-2 frames, each letter popping in blurred then sharp
effects.rebuild: Fusion: a Text+ per label with the Write On (Characters) range keyframed 0 > 1 over 6-10 frames (one character per 1-2 frames), each row = icon + Text+ merged, the whole stack on a Transform whose Center Y moves up ~1 row every 10 frames (linear); Motion Blur on the Transform (Quality 6, Shutter 180) gives the vertical smear. For the glitch frames f1 and f3: a 1-frame Invert (Color Curves / Channel Booleans inverted) at f1 and a 1-frame horizontal-line pattern (FastNoise lines or a 2-px black/white stripe Background, Merge Multiply) at f3.

effects.label: Zoom in
effects.what: As 'Mail' types in, the whole list pushes toward the camera: x1.03 at f28 (00:00:00:28), x1.05 f29, peak x1.07 at f30 (00:00:01:00), then x1.06, x1.03, x1.02 and back to x1.01 by f34 (00:00:01:04). The rows keep scrolling up during it. A pulse, not a sustained zoom: it reads as the list 'landing' before the title takes over at f38.
effects.timing: not on a beat (nearest beat -7.1 frames from the key frame)
effects.easing: S-curve in (2 frames), decelerating out (slow end) over 4 frames; total 6 frames
effects.rebuild: Fusion: Transform Size keyframes 1.00 at f27, 1.07 at f30, 1.00 at f34 (ease in/out); or in After Effects a scale pulse 100 > 107 > 100 over 7 frames on the list pre-comp.

effects.label: Text / graphics
effects.what: At f37-38 (00:00:01:07-00:00:01:08) the Settings and Mail rows fly off (up-left and down-left) with heavy motion blur and are gone by f39-40; the Maps icon stays centred and shrinks (scale x0.97, x0.95, x0.94 at f40 (00:00:01:10), settling x0.96) while the title letters fly in: 'Let's' from the left f38-41 and 'Plan' dropping in letter by letter f40-45 (00:00:01:10-00:00:01:15), each letter arriving oversized and settling. The measured -20 % is the Maps icon pulling back, not a camera zoom.
effects.timing: not on a beat (nearest beat +2.9 frames from the key frame)
effects.easing: scatter: accelerating (slow start) over 3 frames; letters: decelerating (slow end), each 3-4 frames; icon: decelerating (slow end) over 5 frames
effects.rebuild: Fusion: the two rows get Transform Center keyframes off-screen over f37-40 with Motion Blur on; the Maps icon's Transform Size 1.0 > 0.8 over f38-42 (ease out). Title: Text+ per word, Layout > Characters with per-character Offset / Size keyframed (letters come from 150 % scale and 40 px off their spot to rest over 4 frames, staggered 1 frame each), Motion Blur on.

effects.label: Text / graphics
effects.what: 'Let's Plan' settles (letters stop jittering by f50). Below it 'Your' types in f45-48 (00:00:01:15-00:00:01:18) left of the Maps icon and 'Adventure' f48-53 (00:00:01:18-00:00:01:23) right of it, both arriving blurred and sharpening by f54 (00:00:01:24). Hold f54-62. From f62-63 (00:00:02:02-00:00:02:03) the Maps icon starts to grow between the words, clearly bigger by f65-67 (00:00:02:05-00:00:02:07), pushing 'Your' and 'Adventure' apart: the start of the fly-through (E006) on the drop at f68.

effects.label: Zoom in
effects.what: While 'Your' and 'Adventure' type in, the whole title group ('Let's Plan' + icon + words) scales up slightly: x1.03 at f48 (00:00:01:18), x1.04 f49-50, x1.03 f51, x1.02 f52, x1.01 f53-54, then it rests. effects.label: Zoom transition
effects.what: Not a mask reveal. On the drop at f68 (00:00:02:08) the virtual camera flies INTO the Maps icon: the icon grows f68-80 (00:00:02:08-00:00:02:20), 'Let's Plan' and the words fade behind it (gone by f76), the icon tilts in perspective at f77-80 (the top edge recedes, bottom edge nearer) and its white pin circle slides to the top; f81-83 (00:00:02:21-00:00:02:23) the frame is fully inside the icon (blue road, green area) with directional blur. Then the blue pin circle with the white arrow fills the left half f84-93 (00:00:02:24-00:00:03:03) and shrinks away f94-99 (00:00:03:04-00:00:03:09) as the camera pulls back from it, until it is a small blue pin at the left centre at f99. Shot B (inside the icon) = f81. Measured progress: 3-12 % B f68-79, 40 % f80, 100 % f81-82, then 72-97 % while the pin shrinks.
effects.timing: starts on the beat (bar 2 beat 1, bar start; offset -0.4 f at 68); ON THE DROP

effects.rebuild: Fusion 3D: the Maps icon as an ImagePlane3D with a Camera3D dolly in on Z from f68 to f82 (ease in, 15 frames) and a small X rotation (-12 deg) from f76 to reproduce the tilt; the title on a plane behind with Opacity 1 > 0 over f70-76. From f81 switch to the 'pin' comp: a blue circle + arrow element at frame size, Transform Size 2.0 at f84 > 0.12 at f99 and Center from (0.35, 0.5) to (0.1, 0.5), ease out; Motion Blur (Quality 8, Shutter 360) on both moves.

effects.label: Unknown / other

In AE: a shape layer with the circle path morphing to the pill path over 4 frames.

effects.label: Glitch
effects.what: The signature transition. f110 (00:00:03:20) the frame is overlaid with horizontal scanlines and the 'Directions' pill shows blue ghost trails; f111 (00:00:03:21) pure black (L0 %); f112 (00:00:03:22) the NEGATIVE of the next frame: dark background with an orange pill (the blue pill inverted); f113 (00:00:03:23) normal colours but the background is pure white (99 %) and the pill still cyan and motion-blurred; f114 the pill is sharp and has a thin black border (the frame is scaled a few px smaller for 1 frame); f115-125 (00:00:03:25-00:00:04:05) hold: the blue 'Directions' pill alone on a white background. f124-125 the pill drops down with vertical blur; from f126 (00:00:04:06) a white rounded card grows out of the pill's top-left (a photo of the Dolomites, blurred then sharp f130-134) while the background returns from white to the usual light grey (98 > 86 % over f126-131); 'Dolomites' types in letter by letter f129-137 (00:00:04:09-00:00:04:17) and 'Italy' under it f135-138. The detector's 'dip to white' is this white background f113-125.

effects.easing: glitch frames: instant (1 frame each); card growth f126-131: decelerating (slow end) over 6 frames; background white > grey: linear over 6 frames
effects.rebuild: Resolve Edit page, 3 single-frame clips between the pin shot and the card shot: f110 = the outgoing frame with a 2-px horizontal stripe pattern (Fusion: Background stripes, Merge Multiply at 60 %) and a 20-px Directional Blur on the pill; f111 = black Solid Color (1 frame); f112 = the incoming frame through an Invert (Fusion: Color Curves inverted, or Channel Booleans 1-x). From f113 the card comp: white Background (keep it pure white until f125, then Gain down to the grey 0.86 over f126-131); the 'Directions' pill; at f126 the card (Rectangle mask with 60-px corners) scaling from 0 at the pill's top-left corner to full over 6 frames (ease out) with the photo inside, 'Dolomites' as Text+ Write On over 9 frames and 'Italy' over 4.

effects.label: Whip pan

A small blue dot appears above the Dolomites card's top-right corner at f144-147 (00:00:04:24-00:00:04:27); from f148 (00:00:04:28) a blue route line draws up and to the right from it while the virtual camera pans right along the line: the card moves left and down with horizontal motion blur (2.0, 2.6, 3.4, 4.5, 6.2 %/f, peak 7.6 % at f153 (00:00:05:03), then 6.8, 4.9, 3.6, 2.9, 2.5 %/f down to f158). On it a white location arrow and the label type in letter by letter: 'R' at f260 (00:00:08:20), 'Ri' f261, 'Rid' f262, 'Ridg' f263, 'Ridge' f264, 'Ridgec' f265 (00:00:08:25), complete 'Ridgecrest' by f268 (00:00:08:28); a second, smaller line 'Working' appears under it from f268 and 'remotely' from f275 (00:00:09:05) as the card grows (E017).
effects.timing: not on a beat (nearest beat +2.7 frames from the key frame)
effects.easing: one character per frame, each letter pops in blurred and sharpens in 2 frames; linear
effects.rebuild: Fusion: Text+ 'Ridgecrest' (white, semi-bold) with Write On 0 > 1 over f260-269 (one character per frame) and a Blur per character via Layout > Characters (Blur 6 > 0 over 2 frames); the arrow glyph before it appears at f260 with a 2-frame scale-in; 'Working remotely' as a second Text+ Write On f268-278.

effects.label: Zoom in
effects.what: Not an iris: the rounded map card scales up until it becomes the full-frame map. Progress 4 % at f266 (00:00:08:26), 9 % f268, 17 % f270 (00:00:09:00), 34 % f272, 63 % f274, 82 % f275, 98 % at f276 (00:00:09:06), 100 % f277; its rounded corners pass the frame edges at f276-277, then it keeps zooming slightly (x1.03 f279, x1.02 f280-282, x1.01 f283 (00:00:09:13)). The text 'Ridgecrest / Working remotely' is part of the card and grows with it to the lower-left corner. The map stays slightly soft (a blurred map texture) - that is the artwork, not a blur effect.
effects.timing: not on a beat (nearest beat +2.2 frames from the key frame)
effects.easing: S-curve (slow start, fastest at f272-275, slow end) over f266-283, 18 frames; the main growth in 11 frames
effects.rebuild: Fusion: the card group (map image inside a 60-px rounded Rectangle mask + the Text+) on one Transform, Size 0.30 at f265 > 1.0 at f277 > 1.06 at f283 (ease in/out, the last part a slow drift); keep the card's Pivot at the frame centre. In AE: scale 30 > 100 % over 12 frames with Easy Ease, then 100 > 106 % over 6 frames.

effects.label: Dip to black
effects.what: Not a white flash within a shot. f298-301 (00:00:09:28-00:00:10:01) the full-frame map pulls back (x0.977, x0.967, x0.949 - accelerating) and blurs (f300-301 smeared). f302 (00:00:10:02, on the beat at f301.7) cuts to the end card: the memoji head and 'olafmotion' wordmark, blurred, on a mid-grey (L33 %); f303-305 the background darkens to black (14 %, 7 %, 3 %) and the logo sharpens. f305-317 (00:00:10:05-00:00:10:17) hold on black while the logo slowly SHRINKS (about 70 % of its f305 size by f317); from f318 (00:00:10:18) it GROWS again and the background lifts from black f322-327 (2, 2, 3, 5, 9, 16 %); the last frame f328 (00:00:10:28) is a flat light grey at 89.1 % (texture 1.97, flat; L001: give the level, not 'white') with the logo washed out in it. That final frame matches the video's light-grey background at f0, so the loop restarts cleanly - the 'flash' is the loop closer.
effects.timing: not on a beat (nearest beat +14.5 frames from the key frame)
effects.easing: zoom out f298-301: accelerating (slow start); fade to black f302-305: decelerating (slow end), 4 frames; logo shrink f305-317: linear; logo grow + fade up f318-327: accelerating (slow start); the last
effects.rebuild: Resolve: on the map clip a Transform Zoom 1.0 > 0.85 over f298-301 (ease in) with a 20-px Directional Blur on the last 2 frames; cut at f302 to the end-card comp. Fusion end card: Background grey 0.33 at f302 > black by f305 (ease out) > black until f321 > 0.16 at f327; the logo (memoji PNG + Text+ 'olaf' light / 'motion' bold, white) with a Blur 10 > 0 px over f302-305 and Transform Size 1.0 at f305 > 0.7 at f317 > 1.0 at f327; the final frame f328 = a Solid Color at RGB 227/227/227 (89 % luma, light grey - not white) at 100 % with the logo at 10 % opacity over it, 1 frame. Make the clip loop by matching that grey to the first frame's background.
